news.headline: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Discloses Increased Voting Rights in Ceres Power
news.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. reported crossing an 8% threshold in voting rights for Ceres Power Holdings plc, driven largely by derivative exposure.

news.headline: Tesla Opens First Retail Location in Argentina
news.summary: Tesla has officially opened its first retail store in Buenos Aires, marking the company's entry into the Argentine market.

news.headline: Compute Exchange Announces Live GPU Capacity Auction at NVIDIA GTC DC
news.summary: Compute Exchange will host a live auction for NVIDIA B200 and B300 GPU capacity on December 2, 2026, during the NVIDIA GTC DC event.

news.headline: JPMorgan Chase CEO Plans Strategy to Offset UK Bank Tax Increase
news.summary: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon has indicated that the firm is developing plans to mitigate the financial impact of a proposed increase in the UK bank tax.

news.headline: NVIDIA Subject to Congressional Probe Regarding China Sales
news.summary: NVIDIA is facing a Congressional probe concerning its ties to the U.S. Commerce Department and potential sales of its technology to China.

news.headline: California Attorney General Launches Investigation into NVIDIA
news.summary: California has initiated an investigation into whether NVIDIA misled investors and the public regarding the presence of its chips in China despite federal export controls.

news.headline: JPMorgan Chase and Citigroup Assisting PayPo with Potential IPO
news.summary: JPMorgan Chase and Citigroup are reportedly advising Polish buy-now-pay-later firm PayPo on preparations for a potential initial public offering in Warsaw.

news.headline: Tesla Plans Live Optimus Demonstration
news.summary: Tesla has announced plans to conduct a live demonstration of its Optimus humanoid robot within the next two months.

news.headline: Danaher Collaborates with Microsoft to Advance AI-Powered Scientific Instrument Connectivity
news.summary: Danaher Corporation is partnering with Microsoft to develop a common agentic platform for scientific instrument control and insight generation using Azure and Microsoft Foundry.

news.headline: 5C Group Joins NVIDIA Partner Network as Data Center Partner
news.summary: 5C Group has announced its designation as an NVIDIA Data Center Partner, focusing on the deployment of rack-scale AI infrastructure.

news.headline: ScaleCapacity Enters Multi-Year Strategic Collaboration Agreement with AWS
news.summary: ScaleCapacity has signed a multi-year strategic collaboration agreement with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to accelerate the adoption of Amazon Connect among customers.

news.headline: Apple Developer Academy Showcase in Pohang
news.summary: Apple held its annual showcase for the Apple Developer Academy in Pohang, South Korea, featuring apps developed by students.

news.headline: Apple Developing Autonomous AI Agent
news.summary: Apple is reportedly developing an autonomous AI agent capable of performing multistep tasks, including writing code, browsing the web, and controlling applications.

news.headline: Tesla Receives Regulatory Approval for Assisted Driving in Italy
news.summary: Italian authorities have granted approval for Tesla's assisted driving system, marking a step forward ahead of broader European Union regulatory processes.

news.headline: JPMorgan Downgrades Scout24 Amid AI Risk Concerns
news.summary: JPMorgan Chase downgraded Scout24 to 'Neutral', citing renewed concerns regarding the impact of artificial intelligence on online portal operators.

news.headline: Democrats Open Probe Into Nvidia Influence on US Megaspeed Investigation
news.summary: Democratic lawmakers have initiated an investigation into NVIDIA's alleged influence regarding the US Megaspeed inquiry.

summary.overview: Q3 was a strong quarter for Alphabet. Our deep full-stack approach is driving momentum across the business with many opportunities ahead.

quotes.title: CEO
quotes.text: Our first-party model APIs are now processing nearly 32 billion tokens per minute, 40% more than last quarter and more than 4x what we processed a year ago.

quotes.speaker: Anat Ashkenazi
quotes.title: CFO
quotes.text: Our full-year 2026 CapEx guidance range of $195 billion to $205 billion remains unchanged.

bearish.text: And on the second question, with regards to my comments, I believe you're referring to the outlook with regards to Search.

quotes.title: CEO
quotes.text: First, we shifted Prime Day into Q2 for most countries, moving significant sales and ad revenue that were in Q3 2025 into Q2 2026, a tailwind to our Q2 2026 rate and a headwind to Q3 2026.

quotes.title: CFO

quotes.speaker: Satya Nadella
quotes.title: Chairman & Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
quotes.text: The number of customers with over 50,000 seats quadrupled year over year, and Accenture now has over 740,000 seats, our largest Copilot win to date.

quotes.text: Therefore, we expect COGS of $29.4 to $29.6 billion or growth of 22% to 23%, including roughly $350 million from the retirement program, and operating expense of $19.3 to $19.4 billion or growth of approximately 7%, including roughly $550 million from the retirement program.

quotes.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
